_doc: Ledger of WebAssembly feature coverage (docs/wasm-features/PLAN.md). corpus: the pinned test suite and converter. phases: status todo | working | verify | done | blocked, in PLAN order. groups: per group the numbers run.py measured at the last commit that recorded them (null until the baseline), and exclusions with their measured reasons.

unconverted.reason: wasm-tools 1.260 has no text syntax for the legacy try/catch/delegate/rethrow (no feature flag); WABT wast2json --enable-exceptions converts it, to be pinned with F8

phases.name: P0 pipeline
phases.doc: corpus.sh, groups.json, run.py (--check / --update against passing.json), the baseline per group (2026-10-07: 29469 of 65874 runnable commands, 31 s on 8 jobs)

phases.name: F1 core and multi-module linking
phases.doc: wasm-to-wasm imports (functions, globals, memories, tables), the REPL's named modules, register and get; the 3.0 details of the core files; signalling NaN bits through arguments and results (got 0x7fe00000 for 0x7fa00000); malformed UTF-8 names (528 assert_malformed of utf8-*)

groups._doc: run.py totals per group: commands passed, failed, unsupported (a later phase), skipped (text modules). baseline = before F1; latest = the last commit that measured.
